codecommitNoApprovalRule.^description: {$COUNT} CodeCommit repository(ies) have no associated approval rule template that requires at least one approval for pull requests into the default branch. Without an approval rule, any principal with codecommit:MergePullRequest* can merge their own change unreviewed, so a single compromised or careless identity can introduce vulnerable or malicious code into the main line. Create an approval rule template that requires one or more approvals (optionally from a defined approval pool) for the default branch and associate it with the repository. Approval rules only gate merging pull requests: a principal with codecommit:GitPush, PutFile or MergeBranches* can still change the default branch directly, so also deny those actions on the default branch with an IAM policy using the codecommit:References condition key.
codecommitNoApprovalRule.shortDesc: Require pull request approvals with an approval rule template
ref: [Associate an approval rule template with a repository]<https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/how-to-associate-template.html>
